-- ============================================================
-- test-11-aborts_pos.fh  –  aborts PASS-Tests (ABT-01..06)
-- ============================================================
module Test.Aborts.Pos

import Test.Support exposing NotFound, InvalidInput, Overflow

-- ABT-01: aborts E ohne when
function lookup(id: Integer) returns String
requires id >= 0
aborts NotFound
ensures String.instr(result, "item") >= 0
is
    if id = 0 then
        abort NotFound
    end if
    return "item-found"
end lookup

-- ABT-02: aborts E when condition
function safe_sqrt(n: Integer) returns Integer
requires n >= 0
aborts InvalidInput when n < 0
ensures result >= 0
is
    if n < 0 then
        abort InvalidInput
    end if
    return n
end safe_sqrt

-- ABT-02: Komplexe when-Bedingung
function divide(a: Integer, b: Integer) returns Integer
requires a >= 0
aborts Overflow when b = 0
ensures result >= 0
is
    if b = 0 then
        abort Overflow
    end if
    return a
end divide

-- ABT-03: Mehrere aborts-Klauseln
function strict_lookup(id: Integer) returns String
requires id > 0
aborts NotFound
aborts InvalidInput when id > 1000
ensures String.instr(result, "id") >= 0
is
    if id > 1000 then
        abort InvalidInput
    end if
    return "id-ok"
end strict_lookup

-- ABT-05: aborts deklariert, aber nie ausgelöst (gültig)
function never_aborts(n: Integer) returns Integer
requires n > 0
aborts NotFound
ensures result > 0
is
    return n
end never_aborts

-- ABT-06: abort in Result-Funktion
function find_or_fail(id: Integer) returns Result<String, NotFound>
requires id >= 0
aborts NotFound
ensures success, String.instr(value, "item") >= 0
is
    if id = 0 then
        abort NotFound
    end if
    return ok "item"
end find_or_fail

end Test.Aborts.Pos
